description: This file defines a PHP trait named CacheTrait within the OrangeHRM project. It provides a method to retrieve a cache instance from the service container, specifically using the Symfony Cache component and OrangeHRM's own FilesystemAdapter. It also uses a trait named ServiceContainerTrait for dependency injection.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Returns a cache adapter instance from the service container, supporting multiple interfaces and the specific FilesystemAdapter.
